1.description:
Will you emerge triumphant?

learntoplay.title: Magic Academy with Anna Margaret | Magic: The Gathering | Marvel’s Spider-Man
learntoplay.description:
Learn to web-sling and spell-sling! 

Are you new to Magic or maybe just need a bit of a refresher? Anna Margaret is here to talk you through everything to expect when you sign up for Magic Academy! We’ve even got some super new Welcome Decks* for you to get started featuring Spider-Man, his friends, and some other familiar faces. Magic Academy runs September 26 – November 13.  

Learn To Play and Deck Building are two separate Magic Academy events. These are on-demand events so please ask your local WPN store if they can run one for you! Check the Locator for your nearest store - https://mtg.social/MTGxAMSPM 

#MTGxSpiderMan #SpiderMan #Marvel #MTG #MagicTheGathering #MagicAcademy #LearnToPlay #DeckBuilding

lorwyneclipsed.title: Commander Party Recap with Becca from Good Time Society | Lorwyn Eclipsed
lorwyneclipsed.description:
Whether you’re a resident of Lorwyn or Shadowmoor, there’s a little something for everyone at Commander Party this season. Embrace the light and shadow like Becca from Good Time Society did and learn some tips for how to come out ahead of your opponents before the planes shift on you! 

Commander Party for Lorwyn Eclipsed runs February 13-19. 

Check the Locator for your nearest event - https://mtg.social/GTSxECLParty 

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #CommanderParty #LorwynEclipsed #GoodTimeSociety

magicacademy.title: Magic Academy with Anna Margaret | Magic: The Gathering | Marvel’s Spider-Man
magicacademy.description:
Learn to web-sling and spell-sling! 

Are you new to Magic or maybe just need a bit of a refresher? Anna Margaret is here to talk you through everything to expect when you sign up for Magic Academy! We’ve even got some super new Welcome Decks* for you to get started featuring Spider-Man, his friends, and some other familiar faces. Magic Academy runs September 26 – November 13.  

Learn To Play and Deck Building are two separate Magic Academy events. These are on-demand events so please ask your local WPN store if they can run one for you! Check the Locator for your nearest store - https://mtg.social/MTGxAMSPM 

#MTGxSpiderMan #SpiderMan #Marvel #MTG #MagicTheGathering #MagicAcademy #LearnToPlay #DeckBuilding

magicpresents.title: Magic Presents: Friendly Neighborhood Drafts with Dani | Magic: The Gathering | Marvel’s Spider-Man
magicpresents.description:

Even if you’ve been here a while or you’re new to the neighborhood, there’s no better way to get drafting. Dani takes you through everything you need to know about Magic Presents: Friendly Neighborhood Drafts, the first official way to play our new Pick-Two format. 

Magic Presents: Friendly Neighborhood Drafts runs September 26 – November 13. 

Check the Locator for your nearest event - https://mtg.social/MTGxDaniSPM

magicthegathering.description:
The second set of Top 8 quarterfinal matches at Mythic Championship VI are stacked! Two MPL players—Andrew Cuneo and Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa—face off with their Selesnya Adventure and Simic Food decks, while Challengers Austin Bursavich and Sebastian Pozzo battle with their Sultai Food and Simic Food decks. Only one player from each match can advance to the semifinals in Richmond.

Full Coverage: https://magic.gg/events/mythic-championship-vi

magicthegathering.title: Semifinals - 2019 Mythic Championship VI
magicthegathering.description:
After an incredible set of quarterfinals, the semifinals of Mythic Championship VI cranks things up further. MPL player and Hall of Fame member Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa (Simic Food) takes on rising Argentinian Challenger Sebastian Pozzo (Simic Food) while Denmark's Oscar Christensen (Sultai Food) battles the officially unretired (and Mythic Invitational Top 4) Challenger Ondřej Stráský (Simic Food), all ready to earn their slot in the finals from Richmond.

Full Coverage: https://magic.gg/events/mythic-championship-vi

magicthegathering.title: World Champions – Pro Files – Ep. 1
magicthegathering.description:
Welcome to Pro Files, an interview series with the top Magic players from around the world. Rich Hagon sits down with the last three Magic: The Gathering World Champions: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, Javier Dominguez, and William Jensen.  The topics bounce between self disciple, playing in teams, being on social media and each players' personal experience of becoming world champion.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

magicthegathering.title: Beyond the Game – Pro Files – Ep. 2
magicthegathering.description:
Join Rich Hagon as he talks with Magic Pro League members Brian Braun-Duin, Autumn Burchett, and Lee Shi Tian. All three have had success at the highest level, and all three have faced challenges away from the table. In these intimate interviews, they discuss issues of mental health, identity, perspective, and more.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

magicthegathering.title: Allez Les Bleus – Pro Files – Ep. 3
magicthegathering.description:
It's all things French this week on Pro Files, as Rich Hagon speaks with Gabriel Nassif, Jean-Emmanuel Depraz, and Raphael Levy. With yellow hats, martial arts, and intellectual beauty, there's something for everyone to enjoy. 




#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

magicthegathering.title: Masters of Draft – Pro Files – Ep. 4
magicthegathering.description:
In this week's Episode, we turn our attention to Limited, with three of the best in the business: Draft Masters Marcio Carvalho and Martin Juza, and the next generation of excellence, Chris Kvartek. Our MPL members talk favorite formats, fundamentals, and the ways that you can get better at the forty card format.

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

magicthegathering.title: Setting the Standard – Pro Files – Ep. 5
magicthegathering.description:
At the heart of Constructed Magic lies Standard, and this week Rich Hagon talks with three of the greats at this ever-changing, ever-challenging discipline: Piotr Glogowski, Ondrej Strasky, and Brad Nelson. We find out what makes them tick, and what gets them results, time after time.

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

magicthegathering.title: Around the Worlds – Pro Files – Ep. 6
magicthegathering.description:
In our penultimate Episode, Rich Hagon chats with three more members of the Magic Pro League, with four World Championship titles between them: Carlos Romao (2002), Shahar Shenar (2013, 2014), and Seth Manfield (2015). Tales of the biggest matches in the game abound, together with trademark humor and insight.

magicthegathering.title: Magic World Championship 30 - Friday - Las Vegas, NV
magicthegathering.description:
Over 100 qualifying players from around the globe will converge on Las Vegas, Nevada, for the crown jewel of competitive Magic. Across four decades, the best and the brightest of each season have met one last time to determine the best of the best and claim two words that resonate with every corner of Magic's kingdom and beyond: World Champion.

Read the full coverage and round by round results at http://www.magic.gg

World Championship 30 will be streamed all three days of the event, October 25–27.

On Friday and Saturday—October 25 and 26—the stream starts at 2 p.m. ET (8 p.m. CEST / 3 a.m. JST) with three rounds of Duskmourn: House of Horror Draft followed by four rounds of Standard Constructed.

On Sunday, October 27, the stream starts at 1 p.m. ET (6 p.m. CET / 2 a.m. JST) with all four quarterfinals matches, followed by the semifinals matches, and concluding with the finals of World Championship 30.

While competitors begin their Friday and Saturday early on-site at MagicCon: Las Vegas, broadcast begins later in the day at 8 p.m. CEST (2 p.m. ET) with a featured drafter to follow into their Round 1 gameplay. As we continue the broadcast, we'll catch up to the tournament, showing a full feature match from every round and reducing downtime until we're pacing live gameplay on a short delay.

The Sunday Top 8 playoff broadcast begins at 6 p.m. CET (1 p.m. ET), showing a full quarterfinal match and then as many games from other quarterfinal matches as possible, moving on to a full semifinal match (and as much of the remaining semifinals match) then the complete finals.

mtg.title: World Champions – Pro Files – Ep. 1
mtg.description:
Welcome to Pro Files, an interview series with the top Magic players from around the world. Rich Hagon sits down with the last three Magic: The Gathering World Champions: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, Javier Dominguez, and William Jensen.  The topics bounce between self disciple, playing in teams, being on social media and each players' personal experience of becoming world champion.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

mtg.title: Beyond the Game – Pro Files – Ep. 2
mtg.description:
Join Rich Hagon as he talks with Magic Pro League members Brian Braun-Duin, Autumn Burchett, and Lee Shi Tian. All three have had success at the highest level, and all three have faced challenges away from the table. In these intimate interviews, they discuss issues of mental health, identity, perspective, and more.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

mtg.title: Allez Les Bleus – Pro Files – Ep. 3
mtg.description:

mtg.title: Masters of Draft – Pro Files – Ep. 4
mtg.description:
In this week's Episode, we turn our attention to Limited, with three of the best in the business: Draft Masters Marcio Carvalho and Martin Juza, and the next generation of excellence, Chris Kvartek. Our MPL members talk favorite formats, fundamentals, and the ways that you can get better at the forty card format.

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

mtg.title: Setting the Standard – Pro Files – Ep. 5
mtg.description:
At the heart of Constructed Magic lies Standard, and this week Rich Hagon talks with three of the greats at this ever-changing, ever-challenging discipline: Piotr Glogowski, Ondrej Strasky, and Brad Nelson. We find out what makes them tick, and what gets them results, time after time.

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

mtg.title: Around the Worlds – Pro Files – Ep. 6
mtg.description:
In our penultimate Episode, Rich Hagon chats with three more members of the Magic Pro League, with four World Championship titles between them: Carlos Romao (2002), Shahar Shenar (2013, 2014), and Seth Manfield (2015). Tales of the biggest matches in the game abound, together with trademark humor and insight.

mtg.title: Magic World Championship 30 - Friday - Las Vegas, NV
mtg.description:
Over 100 qualifying players from around the globe will converge on Las Vegas, Nevada, for the crown jewel of competitive Magic. Across four decades, the best and the brightest of each season have met one last time to determine the best of the best and claim two words that resonate with every corner of Magic's kingdom and beyond: World Champion.

Read the full coverage and round by round results at http://www.magic.gg

World Championship 30 will be streamed all three days of the event, October 25–27.

On Friday and Saturday—October 25 and 26—the stream starts at 2 p.m. ET (8 p.m. CEST / 3 a.m. JST) with three rounds of Duskmourn: House of Horror Draft followed by four rounds of Standard Constructed.

On Sunday, October 27, the stream starts at 1 p.m. ET (6 p.m. CET / 2 a.m. JST) with all four quarterfinals matches, followed by the semifinals matches, and concluding with the finals of World Championship 30.

While competitors begin their Friday and Saturday early on-site at MagicCon: Las Vegas, broadcast begins later in the day at 8 p.m. CEST (2 p.m. ET) with a featured drafter to follow into their Round 1 gameplay. As we continue the broadcast, we'll catch up to the tournament, showing a full feature match from every round and reducing downtime until we're pacing live gameplay on a short delay.

The Sunday Top 8 playoff broadcast begins at 6 p.m. CET (1 p.m. ET), showing a full quarterfinal match and then as many games from other quarterfinal matches as possible, moving on to a full semifinal match (and as much of the remaining semifinals match) then the complete finals.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #MTGWorlds

mtg.title: Unveiling the Magic Spotlight Series Infinity Gauntlet Trophy | Marvel | East Continental Gems​
mtg.description:
William ‘Huey’ Jensen, Senior Director of Magic Play Programs, and Yoni Mirzoff, Vice President of East Continental Gems, sat down to do an unboxing of the Magic Spotlight Infinity Gauntlet Trophy and talk about the creation of this incredibly special piece while at MagicCon: Atlanta.​

You’ll have the chance to win one of these trophies at the upcoming Magic Spotlight: Spider-Man events in Baltimore, Maryland on October 24-26 and Liverpool, England on October 31 – November 2.​

These winner's trophies are nine-inch, collector quality bronze trophies with an 18k gold bezel and five recessed bronze knuckles made by the artisans at East Continental Gems. True to Magic: The Gathering | Marvel's Spider-Man, they are embedded with a semi-precious Madeira Citrine stone to represent the Soul Stone.

Learn more about the 2026 Spotlight Series & Pro Tour schedule: https://mtg.social/376e63

mtgworlds.title: Magic World Championship 30 - Friday - Las Vegas, NV
mtgworlds.description:
Over 100 qualifying players from around the globe will converge on Las Vegas, Nevada, for the crown jewel of competitive Magic. Across four decades, the best and the brightest of each season have met one last time to determine the best of the best and claim two words that resonate with every corner of Magic's kingdom and beyond: World Champion.

Read the full coverage and round by round results at http://www.magic.gg

World Championship 30 will be streamed all three days of the event, October 25–27.

On Friday and Saturday—October 25 and 26—the stream starts at 2 p.m. ET (8 p.m. CEST / 3 a.m. JST) with three rounds of Duskmourn: House of Horror Draft followed by four rounds of Standard Constructed.

On Sunday, October 27, the stream starts at 1 p.m. ET (6 p.m. CET / 2 a.m. JST) with all four quarterfinals matches, followed by the semifinals matches, and concluding with the finals of World Championship 30.

While competitors begin their Friday and Saturday early on-site at MagicCon: Las Vegas, broadcast begins later in the day at 8 p.m. CEST (2 p.m. ET) with a featured drafter to follow into their Round 1 gameplay. As we continue the broadcast, we'll catch up to the tournament, showing a full feature match from every round and reducing downtime until we're pacing live gameplay on a short delay.

The Sunday Top 8 playoff broadcast begins at 6 p.m. CET (1 p.m. ET), showing a full quarterfinal match and then as many games from other quarterfinal matches as possible, moving on to a full semifinal match (and as much of the remaining semifinals match) then the complete finals.

Rich Hagon, Maria Bartholdi, Paul Cheon and Marshall Sutcliffe take a look at the formats, World Championship race, and $500,000 in prizes all up for grabs in Richmond, Virginia at Mythic Championship VI. Tune in Friday, starting at 9 a.m. ET / 6 a.m. PT on Friday, November 8th-10th on twitch.tv/magic.

profiles.title: World Champions – Pro Files – Ep. 1
profiles.description:
Welcome to Pro Files, an interview series with the top Magic players from around the world. Rich Hagon sits down with the last three Magic: The Gathering World Champions: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, Javier Dominguez, and William Jensen.  The topics bounce between self disciple, playing in teams, being on social media and each players' personal experience of becoming world champion.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

profiles.title: Beyond the Game – Pro Files – Ep. 2
profiles.description:
Join Rich Hagon as he talks with Magic Pro League members Brian Braun-Duin, Autumn Burchett, and Lee Shi Tian. All three have had success at the highest level, and all three have faced challenges away from the table. In these intimate interviews, they discuss issues of mental health, identity, perspective, and more.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

profiles.title: Allez Les Bleus – Pro Files – Ep. 3
profiles.description:
It's all things French this week on Pro Files, as Rich Hagon speaks with Gabriel Nassif, Jean-Emmanuel Depraz, and Raphael Levy. With yellow hats, martial arts, and intellectual beauty, there's something for everyone to enjoy. 




#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

profiles.title: Masters of Draft – Pro Files – Ep. 4
profiles.description:
In this week's Episode, we turn our attention to Limited, with three of the best in the business: Draft Masters Marcio Carvalho and Martin Juza, and the next generation of excellence, Chris Kvartek. Our MPL members talk favorite formats, fundamentals, and the ways that you can get better at the forty card format.

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

profiles.title: Setting the Standard – Pro Files – Ep. 5
profiles.description:
At the heart of Constructed Magic lies Standard, and this week Rich Hagon talks with three of the greats at this ever-changing, ever-challenging discipline: Piotr Glogowski, Ondrej Strasky, and Brad Nelson. We find out what makes them tick, and what gets them results, time after time.

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

profiles.title: Around the Worlds – Pro Files – Ep. 6
profiles.description:
In our penultimate Episode, Rich Hagon chats with three more members of the Magic Pro League, with four World Championship titles between them: Carlos Romao (2002), Shahar Shenar (2013, 2014), and Seth Manfield (2015). Tales of the biggest matches in the game abound, together with trademark humor and insight.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

profiles.title: The Builders – Pro Files – Ep. 7
profiles.description:
This week, we join the three Japanese members of the Magic Pro League. Host Rich Hagon talks with two of the best deckbuilders of all time - Ken Yukuhiro and Shota Yasooka - and gets to know the next in line, Rei Sato. Plus, we get a glimpse into Japan's storied MTG culture.


#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles

profiles.title: Leaving a Legacy - Pro Files - Ep. 8
profiles.description:
As we close out season 1 of Pro Files, Rich Hagon joins Andrea Mengucci, Reid Duke, and Andrew Cuneo to talk all things Legacy, the highlights of their history-spanning careers, and the changing face of our favorite game.


Thanks for watching Pro Files! Please watch the upcoming Players Tour Finals happening July 25-26, and August 1. We welcome ideas for other content you'd like to see in the future here in the comments.

#MTG #MagicTheGathering #ProFiles
